import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    count = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        if (j - i) % 2 == 0:
            count += 1
        i = j
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
